text: iv WHO consolidated guidelines on tuberculosis. Module 6: tuberculosis and comorbidities Acknowledgements The production and writing of the WHO consolidated guidelines on tuberculosis. Module 6: TB and comorbidities were coordinated by Annabel Baddeley, Anna Carlqvist and Kerri Viney, under the guidance of Farai Mavhunga and overall direction of Tereza Kasaeva, Director of the World Health Organization (WHO) Global Tuberculosis Programme. In addition, thanks to the following WHO staff and consultants from the Global HIV, Hepatitis and STIs Programmes, who provided input into the accompanying operational handbook: Rachael Baggaley, Magdalena Barr-DiChiara, Nathan Ford, Fabrizia del Greco, Meg Doherty, Cheryl Johnson, Celine Lastrucci, Morkor Newman, Ajay Rangaraj, Lara Vojnov, Elena Vovc. The WHO Global Tuberculosis Programme gratefully acknowledges the contribution of all experts involved in developing the guidelines that are consolidated within these guidelines. This update was funded by grants provided to WHO by the United States Agency for International Development and the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
